## How to use

### Compute dataset stats (on dataset folder generated by gen_dataset.py):

```bash
python src/nn/scripts/compute_dataset_stats.py \
  --manifest dataset/train/manifest.csv \
  --root dataset/train \
  --out dataset/train/stats.json
```

### Edit training YAML

e.g. Modify src/nn/train_unet.yaml   , by
filling flow_scale, force_scale, log_alpha estimated from previously step saved to **stats.json**.

### Train:

```bash
python -m src.nn.train --config src/nn/train_unet.yaml
```

### Infer Test:

```bash
python -m src.nn.infer \
  --config src/nn/train_unet.yaml \
  --ckpt outputs/ckpt/best.pth \
  --outdir outputs/predictions
```
